{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "dashboard/goals.schema.json",
  "title": "goal (G); a factory goal also needs board {label,url} (checked in dashboard_schema invariants)",
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "iso": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]{3})?Z$"},
    "isoOrNull": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}]},
    "req": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"},
                      {"type": "object", "required": ["at"], "additionalProperties": false,
                       "properties": {"at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "by": {"type": "string"}, "refresh": {"type": "boolean"}}}]}
  },
  "required": ["kind", "rank", "title", "lifecycle", "updated"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "kind": {"enum": ["standing", "directed", "factory"]},
    "board": {"type": "object", "required": ["label", "url"], "additionalProperties": false,
              "properties": {"label": {"type": "string"}, "url": {"type": "string"}}},
    "repo": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[^/ ,]+/[^/ ,]+(, [^/ ,]+/[^/ ,]+)*$"},
    "created": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
    "rank": {"type": "integer"},
    "title": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
    "lifecycle": {"enum": ["active", "parked", "done", "removed"]},
    "status_line": {"type": "string"},
    "updated": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
    "finish_line": {"type": "string"},
    "next_milestone": {"type": "string"},
    "reconciled_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "reconcile_note": {"type": "string"},
    "reconcile_flags": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
    "sessions": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}},
    "rank_set_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "rank_set_by": {"type": "string"},
    "removed_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
    "parked": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"},
                         {"type": "object", "required": ["choice", "at", "by"], "additionalProperties": false,
                          "properties": {"until": {"$ref": "#/$defs/isoOrNull"}, "choice": {"const": "owner"},
                                         "at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "by": {"type": "string"}}}]},
    "park_ack": {"$ref": "#/$defs/isoOrNull"},
    "brief": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[^/]+/docs/briefs/.+[.]md$"}, "brief_request": {"$ref": "#/$defs/req"},
    "unparked_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "unparked_by": {"type": "string"},
    "done_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "done_by": {"type": "string"}, "done_note": {"type": "string"}, "done_ack": {"$ref": "#/$defs/isoOrNull"},
    "reopened_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "reopened_by": {"type": "string"},
    "kind_set_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "kind_set_by": {"type": "string"}, "kind_ack": {"$ref": "#/$defs/isoOrNull"},
    "steer_requests": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["text", "at", "by"], "additionalProperties": false,
                                                  "properties": {"text": {"type": "string"}, "at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "by": {"type": "string"},
                                                                 "relayed_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}}}}
  }
}
files.schemas/dashboard/instructions.schema.js:
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "dashboard/instructions.schema.json",
  "title": "instruction (the Architect's read-back of what the owner asked, merged across several of his prompts, each prompt cited; doc id = durable code IN + 4 hex)",
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "iso": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]{3})?Z$"},
    "iso_or_null": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}]},
    "code": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^IN[0-9a-f]{4}$"},
    "cite": {"type": "object", "required": ["channel", "ref", "ts"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "channel": {"enum": ["chat", "pane", "dashboard", "palace"], "description": "chat = a Claude or Codex turn, pane = a PM pane, dashboard = a D/Q answer or an Instructions page action, palace = a memory drawer (unverifiable, trust recorded)."},
        "ref": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^(claude:[0-9a-f-]{36}#[0-9a-f-]{36}|codex:[0-9a-f]{12}|dash:[A-Za-z0-9._-]+@[0-9TZ:.-]+|palace:[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)$"},
        "ts": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}}},
    "verified": {"type": "object", "required": ["state", "at", "by"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "state": {"enum": ["verified", "relayed", "unverified", "unavailable"]},
        "at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
        "by": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
        "step": {"type": "string", "description": "The verification step that failed (locate, owner_turn, quote, time, hash); absent when verified."}}},
    "source": {"type": "object", "required": ["sid", "cite", "quote", "quote_sha256", "role", "added_in_rev", "verified"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "sid": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^s[0-9]+$"},
        "cite": {"$ref": "#/$defs/cite"},
        "quote": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "description": "The owner's verbatim words (the minimal supporting span); never paraphrased, never edited."},
        "quote_sha256": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"},
        "role": {"enum": ["origin", "sharpens", "confirms"]},
        "added_in_rev": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1},
        "trust": {"enum": ["direct", "relayed", "recorded"], "description": "relayed = the owner's words as relayed by Codex; recorded = a palace drawer or ledger entry that could not be located in a transcript."},
        "note": {"type": "string"},
        "verified": {"$ref": "#/$defs/verified"}}},
    "history": {"type": "object", "required": ["rev", "at", "by", "change"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "rev": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1},
        "at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
        "by": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
        "change": {"enum": ["create", "amend", "confirm", "supersede", "end", "conflict", "resolve", "revert", "adr"]},
        "text_before": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
        "text_after": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
        "basis": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^s[0-9]+$"}},
        "classification": {"type": "object", "required": ["call", "decided_by", "rationale"], "additionalProperties": false,
          "properties": {"call": {"enum": ["create", "amend", "supersede", "confirm", "adr", "reclassify"]}, "decided_by": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}, "rationale": {"type": "string"}}},
        "reason": {"type": "string"}}},
    "outcome": {"type": "object", "required": ["item", "at", "text"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {"item": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}, "at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "text": {"type": "string"}}},
    "note": {"type": "object", "required": ["at", "text"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {"at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "text": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}}},
    "conflict": {"type": "object", "required": ["with", "found_at", "summary", "state"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {"with": {"type": "string"}, "found_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "summary": {"type": "string"}, "state": {"enum": ["open", "resolved"]}, "resolution": {"type": "string"}}},
    "adr": {"type": "object", "required": ["path", "number", "title", "project", "status", "linked_at", "relation"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "path": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "description": "ADR file path, relative to the project repo (absolute when outside it)."},
        "number": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0},
        "title": {"type": "string"},
        "project": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "description": "Project slug the ADR lives in; architect = this installation's repo."},
        "status": {"enum": ["draft", "accepted", "superseded"], "description": "Proposed = draft; Accepted or Amended = accepted; Superseded or Rejected = superseded."},
        "linked_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
        "relation": {"enum": ["converted", "linked"], "description": "converted = written from this instruction; linked = an existing ADR attached."}}},
    "owner_action": {"type": "object", "required": ["type", "at", "by", "status"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "type": {"enum": ["confirm", "correct", "adr"], "description": "confirm = the wording is right; correct = the wording is wrong, text says how; adr = convert this instruction into a draft ADR (project names the target)."},
        "text": {"type": "string"},
        "project": {"type": "string", "description": "adr only: the target project (tm registry name or an absolute repo path); empty or absent = the Architect's own repo."},
        "rev": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "description": "The revision the owner was looking at when he clicked; a confirm applies to that revision, never a later one."},
        "at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
        "by": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
        "status": {"enum": ["new", "applied"], "description": "The page writes new; only instructions.py apply-action sets applied."},
        "reply": {"type": "string"},
        "applied_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}}}
  },
  "required": ["title", "text", "kind", "scope", "status", "rev", "confirmed", "sources", "history", "supersedes", "superseded_by", "created", "updated"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "title": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[^\\n]{1,120}$"},
    "text": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[^\\n]{1,600}$", "description": "The CURRENT distilled instruction: one paragraph, at most 600 characters. Architect-authored wording that adds nothing the sources do not say."},
    "kind": {"enum": ["limit", "scope", "hold", "model", "gate", "approval", "note"]},
    "params": {"type": "object"},
    "scope": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^(fleet|project:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*|session:[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)$"},
    "tags": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}},
    "effective": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"from": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "until": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "event": {"type": "string"}}},
    "status": {"enum": ["active", "superseded"], "description": "Only these two exist (Bob 2026-11-07 17:04Z). Confirmation is a field (confirmed), not a state."},
    "rev": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1},
    "confirmed": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"type": "object", "required": ["rev", "by", "at"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {"rev": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1}, "by": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}, "at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}}}]},
    "sources": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/source"}},
    "history": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/history"}},
    "supersedes": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/code"}},
    "superseded_by": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/code"}},
    "ended_by": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"type": "object", "required": ["cite", "ts"], "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"cite": {"$ref": "#/$defs/cite"}, "ts": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}}}]},
    "applies_when": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "description": "One line, at most 200 characters (checked by instructions.py). The trigger or situation the behaviour applies in (Bob 2026-11-10 20:28Z bright line). Required on every record created or amended after 2026-11-10; older records lack it."},
    "can_be_marked_done": {"const": false, "description": "The recorded classification: an instruction has no finish line. Always false; a record that can be marked done is a task, not an instruction."},
    "moved_to_task": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"type": "object", "required": ["task_ref", "note", "at", "by"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {"task_ref": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^(ar-)?T[0-9a-km-np-z]{2,}$"}, "note": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}, "at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "by": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}}}],
      "description": "Set by `instructions.py reclassify`: the record was a task (it can be marked done); it ends here and points to its task."},
    "outcomes": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/outcome"}},
    "architect_notes": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/note"}},
    "conflicts": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/conflict"}},
    "reconciled_through": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso_or_null"},
    "adrs": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/adr"}},
    "owner_action": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"$ref": "#/$defs/owner_action"}]},
    "created": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
    "updated": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}
  }
}
files.schemas/dashboard/items.schema.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "dashboard/items.schema.json",
  "title": "item (decision D, ask A, task T, request R)",
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "iso": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]{3})?Z$"},
    "isoOrDate": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]{3})?Z)?$"},
    "runTime": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])(T([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9](:[0-5][0-9])?Z)?$"},
    "runLogEntry": {"type": "object", "required": ["at"], "additionalProperties": false,
                    "properties": {"at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/runTime"}, "note": {"type": "string"},
                                   "duration_s": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0}}},
    "isoOrNull": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}]},
    "link": {"type": "object", "required": ["label", "url"], "additionalProperties": false,
             "properties": {"label": {"type": "string"}, "url": {"type": "string"}}},
    "itemLink": {"oneOf": [{"type": "string"},
                           {"type": "object", "required": ["label"], "additionalProperties": false,
                            "properties": {"label": {"type": "string"}, "item": {"type": "string"}, "url": {"type": "string"}}}]},
    "marker": {"type": "integer", "minimum": -3, "maximum": 3},
    "req": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"},
                      {"type": "object", "required": ["at"], "additionalProperties": false,
                       "properties": {"at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "by": {"type": "string"}, "refresh": {"type": "boolean"}}}]},
    "option": {"type": "object", "required": ["label", "desc"], "additionalProperties": false,
               "properties": {"label": {"type": "string"}, "desc": {"type": "string"}, "recommended": {"type": "boolean"},
                              "markers": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
                                          "properties": {"work": {"$ref": "#/$defs/marker"}, "scope": {"$ref": "#/$defs/marker"}, "risk": {"$ref": "#/$defs/marker"}}}}},
    "step": {"type": "object", "required": ["title"], "additionalProperties": false,
             "properties": {"id": {"type": "string"}, "title": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}, "detail": {"type": "string"},
                            "links": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/link"}},
                            "values": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
                            "done": {"type": "boolean"}, "optional": {"type": "boolean"}}},
    "parked": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"},
                         {"type": "object", "required": ["choice", "at", "by"], "additionalProperties": false,
                          "properties": {"choice": {"enum": ["tomorrow", "nextweek", "owner", "stale", "clarify"]},
                                         "until": {"$ref": "#/$defs/isoOrNull"}, "at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "by": {"type": "string"},
                                         "reason": {"type": "string"}, "relayed_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
                                         "clarify": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
                                                     "properties": {"dimension": {"enum": ["work", "scope", "risk", "general"]},
                                                                    "option": {"type": ["string", "null"]}}}}}]},
    "wont_do_entry": {"type": "object", "required": ["at"], "additionalProperties": false,
                      "properties": {"at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "by": {"type": "string"}, "attempts": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 1},
                                     "note": {"type": "string"}}}
  },
  "required": ["kind", "status", "title", "session", "goal", "rank", "created", "updated"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "kind": {"enum": ["question", "action", "task"]},
    "status": {"enum": ["open", "answered", "done", "wont_do", "cancelled"]},
    "title": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
    "detail": {"type": "string"}, "detail_note": {"type": "string"}, "detail_ref": {"type": "string"},
    "doc": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[^/]+/docs/briefs/.+[.]md$"},
    "brief": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[^/]+/docs/briefs/.+[.]md$"},
    "brief_request": {"$ref": "#/$defs/req"},
    "session": {"type": "string"},
    "task": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^T[0-9a-km-np-z]+$"},
    "goal": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"type": "string", "pattern": "^G[0-9a-km-np-z]{2}$"}]},
    "goal_legacy": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}]},
    "rank": {"type": "integer"},
    "urgent": {"type": "boolean"}, "blocks_session": {"type": "boolean"},
    "due": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"$ref": "#/$defs/isoOrDate"}]},
    "eta": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"$ref": "#/$defs/isoOrDate"}]},
    "parked_until": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"$ref": "#/$defs/isoOrDate"}]},
    "status_requested_at": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}]}, "nudge_requested_at": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}]}, "nudge_cleared_at": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}]},
    "instruction": {"type": "string"}, "consolidate_requested_at": {"oneOf": [{"type": "null"}, {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}]},
    "created": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "updated": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "done_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "done_by": {"type": "string"},
    "outcome": {"type": "string"},
    "run_start": {"$ref": "#/$defs/runTime"}, "run_end": {"$ref": "#/$defs/runTime"},
    "run_schedule": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/runTime"}},
    "run_log": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/runLogEntry"}},
    "options": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/option"}},
    "attachments": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["name", "stored_name", "size", "sha256", "uploaded_at", "path", "il"], "additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}, "stored_name": {"type": "string"}, "size": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0}, "sha256": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9a-f]{64}$"}, "uploaded_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "path": {"type": "string"}, "il": {"enum": ["project", "architect-fallback", "session"]}, "type": {"type": "string"}}}},
    "specs": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/link"}},
    "links": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/itemLink"}},
    "steps": {"type": "array", "items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/step"}},
    "plan": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["title"], "additionalProperties": false,
                                        "properties": {"title": {"type": "string"}, "detail": {"type": "string"}}}},
    "plan_title": {"type": "string"},
    "answer": {"type": ["string", "null"]}, "answer_note": {"type": "string"},
    "answered_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/isoOrNull"}, "owner_note": {"type": "string"},
    "cancelled_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "cancelled_by": {"type": "string"}, "cancel_note": {"type": "string"},
    "parked": {"$ref": "#/$defs/parked"},
    "resume_request": {"$ref": "#/$defs/req"}, "status_request": {"$ref": "#/$defs/req"},
    "progress_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
    "status_note": {"type": "string"}, "status_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
    "steer_requests": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["text", "at", "by"], "additionalProperties": false,
                                                  "properties": {"text": {"type": "string"}, "at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "by": {"type": "string"},
                                                                 "relayed_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}}}},
    "status_briefs": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["id", "at", "brief"], "additionalProperties": false,
                                                 "properties": {"id": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^MB[0-9a-fA-F]{4,}$"}, "at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
                                                                "brief": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[^/\\s]+/\\S+\\.md$"}}}},
    "log": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["at", "text"], "additionalProperties": false,
                                       "properties": {"at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "text": {"type": "string"}}}},
    "updates": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["at", "text"], "additionalProperties": false,
                                           "properties": {"at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "by": {"type": "string"}, "text": {"type": "string"}}}},
    "progress": {"type": "object", "required": ["pct", "estimated_at"], "additionalProperties": false,
                 "properties": {"pct": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0, "maximum": 100}, "eta": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
                                "eta_low": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "eta_high": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
                                "confidence": {"enum": ["low", "medium", "high"]}, "basis": {"type": "string"},
                                "estimated_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}}},
    "projects": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
    "il": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-z][a-z0-9]{1,7}-T[0-9a-km-np-z]{2}$"},
    "remaining": {"type": "string"},
    "tokens": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false,
               "properties": {"est_in": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0}, "est_out": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0},
                              "act_in": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0}, "act_out": {"type": "integer", "minimum": 0},
                              "models": {"type": "string"}, "label": {"type": "string"}}},
    "factory": {"type": "object", "required": ["session", "actions", "cadence"], "additionalProperties": false,
                "properties": {"session": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
                               "actions": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}},
                               "cadence": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^(daily|2x-daily|[1-9][0-9]*h)$"},
                               "last_run_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/isoOrNull"}, "next_due": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
                               "state": {"enum": ["waiting", "moving", "overdue"]}}},
    "refs": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}},
    "last_msg_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "last_signal_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},

{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "dashboard/questions.schema.json",
  "title": "question (the Architect's answer to an owner question, kept until the owner clears it)",
  "type": "object",
  "$defs": {
    "iso": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]{3})?Z$"},
    "iso_or_empty": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]{3})?Z)?$"}
  },
  "required": ["title", "asked", "answer", "status", "updated"],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "title": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1, "description": "Short plain title (about 10 words) shown on the row; required."},
    "read_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso_or_empty", "description": "Set when the owner clicks the title; absent or empty = unread."},
    "asked": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
    "asked_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso_or_empty"},
    "task": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^T[0-9a-km-np-z]+$"},
    "answer": {"type": "string"},
    "links": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["label", "url"], "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {"label": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}, "url": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^https?://"}}}},
    "brief": {"type": "string", "pattern": "^[^/]+/docs/briefs/.+[.]md$"},
    "session": {"type": "string"},
    "status": {"enum": ["pending", "answered", "cleared", "open"], "description": "pending = asked, answer not yet given; answered = answer given, not cleared; cleared = owner marked it read (the Read filter; the status name predates the label). open is the legacy spelling of answered, still accepted."},
    "answered_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso_or_empty"},
    "cleared_at": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso_or_empty"},
    "updated": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"},
    "thread": {"type": "array", "description": "Flat follow-ups (Bob 2026-11-09): oldest first. The owner appends an entry with answer null and sets status back to pending; the Architect fills answer and answered_at, then sets status answered.",
      "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["asked", "question", "answer", "answered_at"], "additionalProperties": false,
        "properties": {"asked": {"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, "question": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1},
          "answer": {"type": ["string", "null"]}, "answered_at": {"oneOf":[{"$ref": "#/$defs/iso"}, {"type": "null"}]}}}}
  }
}
